function: Over-the-air gradient aggregation for federated learning among vehicles: receive-beamforming and transmit-scaling design minimizing aggregation MSE (DC programming), plus adaptive local iterations by remaining computing resources (pp. 4-7).
system: One cloud server with 50 antennas, 50 single-antenna vehicles, uplink AirComp, 26 dBm maximum power, noise -10 to -4 dBm; carrier frequency not stated; no RIS (pp. 4, 8).
method: CNN (4 conv, 2 FC layers) trained by federated learning with over-the-air aggregation; local iterations adapted to computing time; receive beamforming by DC programming, not learned (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: GTSRB traffic-sign images (4 classes, 7000, IID over 50 vehicles); channel vectors h_i in C^K are named but no model, dataset or measurement is given (pp. 5, 7-8).
test_conditions: Images split 90/10 for train and test; separate runs with 5, 15 or 25 unavailable clients and noise -10, -6 or -4 dBm; IID data (pp. 7-10).
baselines: Synchronous FL; AFO-FL (asynchronous FL, no citation given); SDR-based OA-FL, the same formulation solved by semidefinite relaxation instead of DC programming (pp. 8, 10).
metrics: Test accuracy, user participation rate, training iteration time per round, training and test loss, accuracy under channel noise (pp. 8-11).
complexity: none for the method; per-round training time only: OA-FL about 25 time units, AFO-FL 8, FL 6 (p. 9).
openness: none; uses the public GTSRB dataset, no code or link (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 5: "uplink channel vector between user i" is only named; no channel model, dataset or measurement is stated (Table II lists only noise and power, p. 8). Missing: any standard or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 8: "involves introducing different numbers of client unavailability during the training process"; each case (5, 15, 25 dropouts; noise -10, -6, -4 dBm, p. 10) is a separate run, a sweep of conditions. Missing: any train/test split across scenarios.
q3_support: p. 8: "AFO-FL: an optimized asynchronous FL method" and synchronous FL are the earlier FL baselines (accuracy and participation rate, Figs. 4-5); p. 10: "compared with the SDR-based OA-FL model" is the non-learned solver baseline (accuracy, Fig. 9).
q4_support: p. 9: "OA-FL requires approximately 25 time units per iteration" is per-round FL latency in time units, not a complexity order, operations, parameters or runtime of the aggregation design. Missing: any complexity analysis.
q5_support: p. 7: "using the opensource GTSRB dataset" is a public dataset of the learning task alone, which does not count; no code or data link is given and no channel dataset is used.
notes: Included as area 7 under the FL over-the-air rule: the learned element is the CNN trained across vehicles, and the over-the-air part is a DC-programming receive-beamforming design that minimizes aggregation MSE (pp. 5-7), classical and not learned. Part of the contribution, the adaptive local iterations by computing resources (p. 5), acts above the physical layer, so the reviewer may weigh the above_phy check. For the reviewer, q3: baselines are synchronous FL and AFO-FL (digital FL, no citation given for AFO-FL) and an SDR solver for the paper's own problem (pp. 8, 10); no earlier over-the-air aggregation design is compared; marked met under the 'earlier published aggregation design' wording, set 0 if judged otherwise. q4: Fig. 6 and p. 10 attribute the longer OA-FL round time to resource detection and the DC algorithm, but give only per-round latency in 'time units'; set 1 if judged a measured runtime. The paper never states a carrier frequency or channel model. Tables I-II are not in the text extraction; they were read from the page image (p. 8).
